title: Enterprise Connectivity: minimum interval volume
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following minimum interval volume for each named contract tier. Minimum primary quantity billed per measured resource interval; decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | minimum interval volume | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | minimum interval volume | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | minimum interval volume | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | minimum interval volume | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | minimum interval volume | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | minimum interval volume | 0 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the minimum interval volume is 0.
